clauses.scope_note: The agreement applies to use of the Kimi 大模型（开放平台） service. It becomes effective upon the user's acceptance click or upon the user's use of the service. New features, products, and services added to the platform are also subject to the agreement, unless laws or regulations expressly provide otherwise.
clauses.condition_explanation: agreement_effective means either the user clicked to accept the agreement or the user used the platform. The exception is an express contrary requirement of law or regulation.

clauses.scope_note: Before using the platform, the user must register and complete real-name authentication. Before beginning registration to use the service, the user must have civil capacity appropriate to the user's conduct under the laws of the People's Republic of China. The agreement states that registration by a person without or with limited civil capacity is void from the outset; upon discovery, the provider may immediately stop providing service or cancel the account. It also assigns resulting losses to the user or guardian and provides for compensation for losses caused to the provider or related parties.
clauses.condition_explanation: user_registered means the user has completed the required registration. user_real_name_authenticated means the user has completed real-name authentication. user_has_legally_appropriate_civil_capacity means the user has the civil capacity appropriate to the user's conduct under PRC law. The account-termination consequence is triggered by discovery that a person without or with limited civil capacity improperly registered. The stated loss and compensation allocation applies to losses resulting from the user's lack of the required qualification.

coverage_notes: The excerpt does not specify the procedures or criteria for registration and real-name authentication.
The excerpt refers to applicable laws and regulations but does not reproduce them.

The excerpt assigns responsibility for losses and compensation but does not supply an activity or modality that faithfully represents those liability allocations; those consequences are noted in scope but not modeled as license activity rules.
The provider's stated rights to stop service, cancel accounts, freeze accounts, or refuse service are not actions available in the supplied activity vocabulary.

paragraph_audit.reason: Title and agreement heading identify the document but impose no operative rule.
Definitions and identification of the provider, platform, and user supply context but do not themselves grant or restrict an activity.
The paragraph establishes when the agreement takes effect and extends its application to new platform features, products, and services, subject to the stated legal exception.
The paragraph lists registration and real-name authentication as prerequisites for use; both are captured as conditions on Use.

The capacity prerequisite and its relationship to Use are modeled, but the paragraph also states that an agreement is void from the outset, permits the provider to stop service or cancel the account, and allocates liability and compensation. These consequences cannot all be represented faithfully with the supplied activities and modalities.

The paragraph defines registration and authorizes freezing or closing accounts and refusing service for improper registration or improper use of multiple accounts, and states a compensation consequence. Those provider actions and liability allocation cannot be represented with the supplied activities and modalities.
